provenance.source: Read-only original rlog modelV2/carControl/carState extraction; no lane-point resampling in stored fixture.
provenance.selection: First active 10..20 m/s native frame in each retained segment with >=30m credible paired-lane support and feasible repaired candidate.
provenance.limitations: Original unselected policy and per-node uncertainty were not published. Tests exercise stateless candidate geometry using scalar published lane uncertainty and selected-plan longitudinal speed. No exact selector-state or closed-loop replay claim.
